spec: the ParCa fits available, joined to runs by kb_sha256
deposit_note: no knowledge base is on the Hugging Face corpus: a deposited run is re-readable for its stored channels, but a read that needs the fit (the two-component sensor correction, BV-R1) needs the fit on the reading machine; publishing fits is held for the user (WAITING_ON_YOU)

fits.basis: the code image's default ParCa (operons on); the knowledge base of most of the corpus
built 2026-08-06 (parca_ts), reconstruction_sha 14c6d826; carries steady-state and kinetic rows; the file is not on this machine
not recorded: a second knowledge base mixed into wildtype/basal and condition/with_aa, seen in the corpus from 2026-07-29 with no parca_ts (docs/DECISIONS.md I2); the file is not on this machine
refit2, PARCA-3: the default fit with the coverage filter (BACKLOG PARCA-3)
BV-14 refit: the code image's flat tree with two files overridden (runner.parca_rebuild flat_overrides, which mounts only the named files)
fits.purpose: BV-14: anaerobic nitrate respiration against PRECISE-1K (Platform Map M.6)
fits.decided_by: the user, 2026-11-25 (BV-12 to BV-14: 'Run them on this machine, 6 in parallel')
fits.overrides_from: model_overlay/files/reconstruction/ecoli/flat/condition/ (identical to the campaign checkout's working tree)
fits.conditions_added_against: the code image's own condition_defs.tsv (24 rows; the override has 25)
fits.against_the_corpus_fit: the corpus fit 3b2f8ebd has 21 ordered conditions (read from its pickle, 2026-11-25); this fit has 25, the same 21 at indices 0-20, then minus_leu, minus_thr, minus_arg (from the image's own table) and no_oxygen_plus_nitrate at 24. It was built from the current image, so anything else that image changed since July is in it too: its validity controls test that basal and anaerobic growth stay inside the corpus fit's range
fits.differs_from_public_branch: the public campaign branch at 8e7dd6c5 carries the same no_oxygen_plus_nitrate row and medium; its condition_defs.tsv also has plus_cytidine, added there by a commit the local checkout lacks, so it hashes 33b5e1dc..., not 6985c6a8..., and every condition index after plus_cytidine's position is one higher on the public branch. Runs on this fit compute their condition index by name from this fit's own table
fits.doubling_time: 82 min, derived: PRECISE-1K no3_anaero 0.35/h against aerobic glucose 0.649/h, scaled to the 44-min basal (data/parca/condition_fits.json)

fits.basis: refit1, PARCA-3: the default fit with G0-10634_RNA retyped from mRNA to pseudo (BACKLOG PARCA-3)
